finish._cont_route_why: 11 September 2026: one continuation pass of the router before the stub router when a handful of connections are open (A21's lever of 5 September). cont_route.sh keeps the board only if it improves, so it cannot make one worse; it was declared for A alone because only the A clones carried it, and E and P both ended a route at exactly one open. 12 September 2026: raised from 6 to 15. C10's 60-pass route ended at ELEVEN opens scattered over eight nets, the stub router closed none of them, and the continuation never ran because eleven is more than six. A threshold that excludes the case it was written for is no threshold; cont_route keeps the board only if it improves, so the only cost of trying is the clock.
